svg.text: Read-along audio for learners • Serverless generation • Least privilege • Cost bounded
security headers • Origin Access Control to S3
encrypted 8 GB gp3 • app bundle from CDK asset
asynchronous • one Step Functions execution per submitted document
Map over parts, max concurrency 1 • 8 h timeout • a crashed part is marked failed in DynamoDB
Per part: Generator → (status = done) → Questions (English) → Translation.
Questions and translation are caught: they never fail an audio job.
Bedrock callers pace themselves to stay under ~1 request/s for the account.
Amazon S3 – site and content bucket
app/ web build • data/ MP3, timing, cards (served by CloudFront)
raw/ uploads + drafts (expire after 7 days) • Block Public Access
every push to main rebuilds and deploys SoundAlongStack on AWS (not on a laptop)
developers push to the main branch
Built from infra/sound_along/*.py. Icons: AWS Architecture Icons (07-31-2026 package).
-c flag is passed to cdk deploy.
